answers.answer: Visitors do not need to obtain a laboratory permit to use the public waiting room, as the material expressly permits them to use it whether or not they have a permit.
Signing the laboratory entry log is a requirement imposed on staff, and visitor waiting-room permission is explicitly independent of staff entry conditions.
The permission applies solely to using the public waiting room and does not authorize entry into the laboratory.
The supplied text directly establishes that the waiting room closes at 18:00.
